recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not recreate or edit the obsolete medication-statement-category ValueSet in core for this historical typo; handle any future medication category terminology consolidation under later Pharmacy/Terminology issue decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-20306 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request, raised in STU3 and applied for R5, reporting that MedicationStatement.category pointed to the medication-statement-category ValueSet while that ValueSet was incorrectly named/described as Medication Status Codes.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records merge 16680e7ffc2f0f3b8cf031ce23e828ec14c2457e as the application. The relevant merged commit 92cc8632039c231c346b3ab90697c9c0537a1a5f changed source/medicationstatement/valueset-medication-statement-category.xml name and description from Medication Status Codes to MedicationStatement Category Codes.
additional_context: MedicationStatement remains active, but current MedicationStatement.category binds to the shared http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-category value set. Later combined-branch decisions for FHIR-31632 and FHIR-32825 document the shared MedicationRequest category vocabulary and removal of the obsolete MedicationStatement category ValueSet source; FHIR-22826 and FHIR-23979 are same-defect audits already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical bad ValueSet metadata was corrected by the original application, and current source has no active medication-statement-category ValueSet definition left to fix; the remaining old URL reference is an OID registry row rather than a built ValueSet definition.
